author: @meghsat

evidence.api_compatibility: LlamaCppServer::downsize() is removed as an override in the header (llamacpp_server.h) and implementation (llamacpp_server.cpp). This is an internal C++ interface — it is not part of any public API, CLI, or configuration contract. The EvictionEngine contract remains unchanged (the base-class downsize() no-op is already the documented default for backends that cannot downsize). No breaking changes.
evidence.documentation: Two doc files were updated. docs/guide/configuration/multi-model.md was corrected to accurately state that downsize for llama.cpp is a no-op that leaves the prompt cache intact. docs/dev/backends-reference.md gained a paragraph explaining the llama.cpp backend's behavior — the reviewer initially flagged this as potentially out-of-context, but the author defended it as addressing an acceptance criterion from the original issue #2961 ('Document the pinned llama-server runtime defaults'). Both changes are accurate and necessary for consistency.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The only user-visible change occurs when `auto_evict=true` is configured: a conversation that goes soft-idle and resumes will now report non-zero `timings.cache_n` instead of re-prefilling its entire history. This requires `auto_evict` to be explicitly enabled (not the default), so it falls outside the common release surface. The existing `test_downsize_idle_timeout` in the server eviction test suite exercises the downsize code path. No manual release test is warranted given the narrow scope and the fact that the change is a method removal that falls through to the documented base-class no-op.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Two commits were added after the first approval (@pwilkin, 2026-09-13T17:10:24Z): (1) 'PR feedback: Removing the test script' — a 55-line deletion of `test_downsize_preserves_prompt_cache` per @bitgamma's review request, which is a reduction in scope consistent with reviewer guidance and does not alter the core fix or weaken tests; (2) a merge of main into the feature branch. No commits were added after the latest approval (@bitgamma, 2026-09-14T05:01:00Z).
evidence.review: PR #3565 was requested for review from @ramkrishna2910, @SlawomirNowaczyk, and @fl0rianr, but substantive review came from @bitgamma (requested changes on an over-scoped test) and @pwilkin (approved after test removal). Both reviewers with llamacpp subject-matter expertise participated (@superm1 and @pwilkin are listed as llamacpp experts in docs/dev/contribute.md). @bitgamma's feedback was practical and scoped: the initial review flagged a test that validated a no-op at the backend level (llamacpp) rather than Lemonade, and @bitgamma also flagged the backend-reference doc addition as potentially confusing out of context. @meghsat addressed both points. @pwilkin's approval noted the PR was 'much better scoped than the previous attempt.' The first approval was from @pwilkin at 2026-09-13T17:10:24Z; the final approval was from @bitgamma at 2026-09-14T05:01:00Z on the merged PR commit. No substantive code changed between first and latest approval beyond the test removal (requested by the reviewer who later approved).
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change removes code that was performing `POST /slots/{id}?action=erase` — the review confirms this action freed zero device memory and only cleared logical KV bookkeeping. No new network calls, credential handling, code execution paths, or permissions are introduced.
evidence.tests: The original PR included a test `test_downsize_preserves_prompt_cache` that was removed in response to reviewer feedback (@bitgamma: 'testing that a no-op is a no-op seems redundant'). The existing `test_downsize_idle_timeout` in test/server_eviction.py still covers the soft-idle downsize path and confirms the model reaches the DOWNSIZED state. There is no new feature test proving the prompt cache is preserved, but the PR explicitly removes the only test that attempted it, and the fix is a simple method removal with no logic to verify. The PR also adds a single constant `CACHE_TEST_CTX_SIZE = 1024` to test/server_eviction.py which is now unused (the test function that used it was deleted).

subject: fix(server): stop erasing llama.cpp slots on soft-idle downsize #2961 (#3565)
summary: Removes the LlamaCppServer::downsize() override so soft-idle no longer erases llama.cpp KV cache slots, preserving the prompt cache instead of destroying it for a zero-VRAM-benefit re-prefill.
verdict_reason: A narrow, well-scoped fix that removes 21 lines of harmful code; it was reviewed by two experts with llamacpp domain knowledge, all CI checks pass, documentation was updated to match, and no problematic post-approval commits were added.
